== Overview & Architectural Fit ==
'''FORM''' is a symbolic manipulation system built for expressions too large for memory, which it streams from disk; TFORM runs it in parallel. FORM 5 adds a Feynman-diagram generator based on GRACE, arbitrary-precision floating-point coefficients and polynomial arithmetic from FLINT. It is built for the very large expressions of multi-loop calculations in particle physics.

== Mathematical Evaluation for TPM ==
* '''Lagrangian / Action (3/10):''' No variational machinery: FORM works after the Feynman rules are fixed.
* '''Field / PDE (2/10):''' Not a field or PDE tool.
* '''Relativity (3/10):''' Lorentz and Dirac algebra in ''d'' dimensions, not curved spacetime.
* '''Quantum / Data (7/10):''' Industrial-scale perturbative quantum-field-theory algebra, including multi-loop work.

== Integration Pipeline ==
# '''Derive the Feynman rules''' from the Lagrangian, for example with [[The Principia Machina/Tools/FeynCalc|FeynCalc]].
# '''Generate''' the diagrams with FORM 5's generator, or import them.
# '''Reduce''' the amplitudes: Dirac traces, colour algebra, tensor reduction, in batch scripts.
# '''Check numerically''' with arbitrary-precision coefficients at chosen kinematic points.

== Status, Licence and Limits ==
* '''Status:''' Active. Latest tagged release 5.0.1, 24 June 2024; the FORM 5 paper was posted on 27 January 2026, so check which of its features the build in use carries.
* '''Licence:''' GPL-3.0.
* '''Home:''' https://github.com/form-dev/form and https://www.nikhef.nl/~form
* '''Limits:''' The language is idiosyncratic and favours batch scripts. Interactive exploration is better done in FeynCalc.

== On the Principia Machina ==
A tool runs only where the sponsor installed and bound it, and what it returns is untrusted input, vetted before use; its numbers are never values of the site's calculator, TPC. An equation it derives is transcribed into the kernel's form grammar before anything checks it, and lands as a RESULT of regime L with EQUATION and ROLE. See [[The Principia Machina/Agent/Tools|Agent/Tools]] and [[The Principia Machina/Tools/Operator's guide|the operator's guide]].
